purpose: Make every local-agent handoff executable from durable state, keep independent work moving, and prevent review or proof gates from collapsing into planning or ceremonial stops.

loop.action: Refresh current main/PR/provider/local state and read canonical contracts. Historical handoff SHAs are evidence floors, never present truth.
loop.exit_when: exact current floor/head, contracts, reviews, runtime/tool availability, and private evidence posture are known
loop.fail_route: repair discovery/context gap or record exact BLOCKED_JUDGMENT_GAP; do not guess

loop.action: Recompute remaining work from completed facts, assign dependencies, one mutation owner per shared surface, forbidden surfaces, proof ceiling, and safe parallel groups.
loop.exit_when: every material remaining work unit has one owner and dependencies are typed
loop.fail_route: convergence owner resolves overlap before dispatch

loop.action: Launch every dependency-ready independent lane through available local/agent execution adapters. Human paste is fallback only when no safe adapter exists.
loop.exit_when: all ready lanes are running, completed, or have an evidenced autonomy gap
loop.fail_route: continue independent lanes; record AUTONOMY_GAP for unavailable adapter

loop.action: Implement bounded owned work. A local agent consumes canonical judgment and scene scripts; it does not re-plan product policy.
loop.exit_when: owned implementation reaches its lane acceptance condition or a genuine external/judgment blocker
loop.fail_route: repair within owned scope; missing product judgment becomes BLOCKED_JUDGMENT_GAP

loop.action: Run the narrowest relevant checks first, then repository-wide checks required by the changed surface. Preserve exact failure evidence.
loop.exit_when: lane proof is green at its honest proof ceiling or an exact failing invariant is known
loop.fail_route: return to EXECUTE with failing evidence; never edit the oracle merely to get green

loop.action: Apply the typed review gates in harness/evals/execution-handoff-review-gates.v1.json. Refresh provider comments/threads against the exact candidate head.
loop.exit_when: all gates required for the next transition pass, or each failure has a named repair owner/route
loop.fail_route: route directly to repair owner; review is not a ceremonial stop

loop.action: Integrate compatible completed lanes in dependency order, refresh affected downstream assumptions, and re-run invalidated proof.
loop.exit_when: current candidate contains the intended completed facts with no stale downstream proof
loop.fail_route: repartition only the invalidated remainder; preserve unaffected completed proof

loop.action: Advance to the next dependency-ready lane or live verification step without asking the operator to relaunch already-authorized work.
loop.exit_when: whole sprint terminal outcome is verified, or only a genuine user/external blocker remains
loop.fail_route: emit one exact blocker plus executable next transition; never return a plan as completion

continuation_rules.gate_pass: advance automatically to the next typed transition
continuation_rules.gate_fail: route to named repair owner and re-enter at the earliest invalidated phase
continuation_rules.local_tests_unavailable: keep local proof UNPROVEN; continue only work whose next gate does not require that proof
continuation_rules.provider_review_present: validate against exact head; repair or disprove before merge
continuation_rules.plan_or_contract_changed: invalidate only proofs whose inputs changed
continuation_rules.user_authority_already_granted: do not re-ask at internal seams
continuation_rules.destructive_or_repair_action_not_covered: obtain the specific missing operator gate before mutation
